result.title: Beyond Co-Generation: Rethinking Jointness in Joint Audio-Video Generation
result.summary: Our aim is to advance the understanding of genuine audio-visual coordination in joint text-to-audio-video (T2AV) generation, with particular emphasis on semantic consistency. Evaluating audio-visual consistency in T2AV generation is nontrivial, as detailed text prompts obscure whether such consistency stems from genuine cross-modal coordination or merely from independent text following. To isolate the former, we introduce intrinsic jointness: the ability of audio and video to produce the same realization for details left underspecified by the prompt. Using semantically underspecified prompts (e.g., "musical instrument playing" rather than "electric guitar playing"), we investigate four recent models and reveal their limited intrinsic jointness. To address this limitation, we propose JointREPA, a simple representation alignment-based post-training method to facilitate cross-modal coordination. Since existing benchmarks use semantically detailed prompts, we introduce UNSAIDBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate intrinsic jointness under semantic underspecification. Experiments across two distinct models and three benchmarks, including UNSAIDBench, demonstrate that JointREPA consistently improves semantic consistency.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出「intrinsic jointness」概念，用语义欠指定的 prompt 检验 T2AV 模型在音视频细节上是否产生一致的实现，发现现有模型该能力有限，并提出基于表示对齐的后训练方法 JointREPA 及对应基准 UNSAIDBench。
AI.relevance_reason: 其以预训练表示对齐约束跨模态细节一致性的后训练思路，可能为 latent 推理状态的训练监督与视觉细节保持提供可核查线索；但论文聚焦音视频生成，不涉及推理期状态生成或答案对 latent 内容的使用。
